fixes.class_code_coverage: Accumulates normalized soft class mass per code in a rolling usage_window_updates cohort window. Repeated cohort IDs replace their row; unique mass history, IDs, and gate coverage survive state_dict resume. A code counts for a class only when that class owns strictly more than half of the code's total mass.
fixes.frozen_reload: A frozen checkpoint reload now restores eval mode and requires_grad=false on all retained tokenizer parameters; tests compare all parameters and buffers exactly.
fixes.canonical_config: Direct canonical tokenizer mappings consume dimension, adapter_hidden, usage_window_updates, anatomy_loss_weight, minimum_perplexity, maximum_dead_code_fraction, minimum_class_codes, and dead_code_fraction. Unknown keys fail closed; the 200-volume initialization default and separate engine Q-update budget remain unchanged.
fixes.dead_code_restart: Dead-code replacement uses an internal seeded CPU generator whose state is persisted in the tokenizer extra state.
fixes.teacher_alignment: Stride 4/8 features use exact full-cell average pooling with kernel/stride (1,16/stride,16/stride), stride 16 is identity, and output is cropped after pooling. Inputs must cover the declared replicate-padded grid, including odd native edges. Reconstruction loss still normalizes by current F_T_aln channel standard deviation.

coverage: two distinct soft-class cohorts across save/load
strict majority versus plurality class ownership
frozen reload exact parameters, buffers, and gradient flags
canonical config consumption and unknown-key rejection
odd-edge exact unweighted 2x2 feature pooling and padded coverage

integration_note: The tokenizer now accepts cohort_id and uses snapshot_id as the cohort ID when supplied. The engine code inspected at implementation time converts pooled teacher probabilities to argmax labels before its Q-stage usage report; end-to-end soft coverage requires the engine owner to preserve and pass soft class probabilities.
